llm_condensed_answer:
SUMMARY: A new method PlanWithFilter needs to be added to the Planner interface in the Thanos repository to allow filtering blocks during the planning phase. This method will be implemented by the core tsdbBasedPlanner and its wrapper filters, while Mimir's own planner implementations will also need to be updated to support it.

FILES:
- thanos/pkg/compact/compact.go — Defines the Planner interface where the new PlanWithFilter method must be added.
- thanos/pkg/compact/planner.go — Contains the primary tsdbBasedPlanner implementation and wrapper filters that need the new method.
- thanos/pkg/compact/planner_test.go — Should be updated to include tests for the new PlanWithFilter functionality.
- mimir/pkg/compactor/split_merge_planner.go — Mimir-specific planner that likely needs to implement the new interface method.
- mimir/pkg/compactor/bucket_compactor.go — Core Mimir compactor that utilizes the Planner interface.
